scope_note: Candidate-only London architecture and built-environment observed changes from 2008-2026. This file is not an ingestion patch and intentionally does not edit authoritative repo data.
dedupe_note: Candidates were checked against data/manual_drops/architecture_milestones/architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json and earlier tmp/subagents London candidate files by proposed event_id, source URL or record id where applicable, and obvious project names.
license_note: This report stores concise factual metadata and source URLs only. Reuse of source prose, images, maps, or database content requires review of each publisher's terms.

candidates.title: LSBU Hub opened after campus-building renovation
candidates.summary: London South Bank University records The Hub opening in summer 2022 after an extensive renovation of its largest Elephant and Castle campus building.
candidates.observed_change: A refurbished university hub with learning, sports, catering, library, study, and community-facing spaces entered use.
candidates.geometry_source: Approximate point for LSBU's Elephant and Castle campus Hub building.
candidates.geometry_precision: Approximate building point, not a measured footprint or campus boundary.

candidates.limitations: Month is approximate because the reviewed source gives season-level timing. The event records opening of the renovated Hub, not the whole Southwark campus strategy.
